name: Deep
summary: A proposed launch model that directs the creator fee share into add-only locked liquidity until an immutable target is reached.
releaseGates: Define immutable TWAP bounds, observation window, cooldown and batch limits.
Bind the pool, hook, add-only position, target and beneficiaries atomically.
Prove fee assignment, target monotonicity and failure-safe compounding.
Pass the complete lifecycle against pinned Ethereum Uniswap v4 deployments.
